description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'For sale' table tab in the Properties
section.

Current for-sale listings in the suburb, with address, price and the
advertised price line (with its low/high range when one is stated),
beds/baths/cars, land and floor area, coordinates, an `off_market` flag, and
the selling agency with its own listing page and named agents.

A listing seen on only one major portal, with no agency page of its own,
keeps its address, type and agency name but not its advertised facts: the
same rule our property finder applies.

`total` is the full number on the market (computed before paging), so a
count is accurate even when the rows are capped. Page through every listing
with `limit`/`offset` — `next_offset` is the next page's offset, null on the
last page; order is newest listing first and stable across pages. Each page
is one call at a flat price. Set `verbose=true` for the agent's full
description text; set `off_market=true` for off-market listings only.

**Price: 20¢ per call.**

limit.description: Max listings to return (default 30, max 200). `total` always reports the full match count.

off_market.description: Only return OFF-MARKET listings: not on the major listing portals, sourced from the agency's own site, and still believed live — our Property Finder's 'Off market only' rule. Default false returns every listing, each carrying its own `off_market` flag. `total` counts the filtered set.

offset.description: Listing offset — page with `limit`. `next_offset` in the response is the value for the next page (null on the last).

verbose.description: Include the agent's full ad-copy in `attributes.description`. Off by default — it averages ~1.5 KB per listing.
